scope: Selected foundational and recent primary research plus one explicitly labeled recent review; not an exhaustive novelty search

references.title: Identification in Parametric Models
references.supports: Foundational statistical distinction between identifiable and observationally equivalent parameterizations; does not establish ambiguity in the current biological experiment

references.authors: A. Raue and C. Kreutz and T. Maiwald and J. Bachmann and M. Schilling and U. Klingmuller and J. Timmer
references.title: Structural and practical identifiability analysis of partially observed dynamical models by exploiting the profile likelihood
references.supports: Structural versus practical identifiability and analysis of observational limitations; current pilot does not implement profile likelihood

references.authors: Serge O. Dumoulin and Brian A. Wandell
references.title: Population receptive field estimates in human visual cortex
references.supports: Forward modeling of visual receptive fields; human fMRI is methodological context rather than evidence for fly optics

references.authors: Peter Zeidman and Edward Harry Silson and Dietrich Samuel Schwarzkopf and Chris Ian Baker and Will Penny
references.title: Bayesian population receptive field modelling
references.supports: Existing receptive-field parameter uncertainty and model comparison methods; DOI and online manuscript date contain 2017, final volume publication is 2018

references.authors: Garikoitz Lerma-Usabiaga and Noah Benson and Jonathan Winawer and Brian A. Wandell
references.title: A validation framework for neuroimaging software: The case of population receptive fields
references.supports: Known-truth software validation distinguished from reproducibility and empirical reliability

references.authors: Eyal Gruntman and Sandro Romani and Michael B. Reiser
references.title: Simple integration of fast excitation and offset, delayed inhibition computes directional selectivity in Drosophila
references.supports: Source experiment and passive T4 model; Supplementary Figure 1 explicitly states two-dimensional mapping for all recorded cells, so selected SingleBar files are not the full experimental mapping procedure

references.authors: Janne K. Lappalainen and Fabian D. Tschopp and Sridhama Prakhya and Mason McGill and Aljoscha Nern and Kazunori Shinomiya and Shin-ya Takemura and Eyal Gruntman and Jakob H. Macke and Srinivas C. Turaga
references.title: Connectome-constrained networks predict neural activity across the fly visual system
references.supports: Existing connectome-constrained visual prediction work; not evidence that the present reanalysis validates any whole circuit

references.authors: Arthur Zhao and Eyal Gruntman and Aljoscha Nern and others
references.title: Eye structure shapes neuron function in Drosophila motion vision
references.supports: Evidence that eye geometry matters to fly motion responses; no quantitative PSF inferred for this pilot's animals

references.title: Prediction of neural activity in connectome-constrained recurrent networks
references.supports: Recent theory of dynamical ambiguity and constraints supplied by recordings; distinct from this pilot's spatial-input uncertainty

references.title: Asymptotic theory of information-theoretic experimental design
references.supports: Foundational experimental-design theory; no novel information-optimal stimulus claim is made here

references.authors: Jeremy Lewi and Robert Butera and Liam Paninski
references.title: Sequential optimal design of neurophysiology experiments
references.supports: Established adaptive stimulus-design methods; actual superiority of a new calibration scheme would need an equal-budget comparison

references.authors: Tal Golan and Heiko H. Schütt and Nikolaus Kriegeskorte
references.title: Making models disagree to learn how brains compute
references.supports: Recent synthesis of stimulus optimization for model discrimination, including nuisance parameters; contextual reference rather than new experimental data
